answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, weighted by independent path length, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. What survives to the dawn is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Work waits on the tide until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the marble of the next round.
